name: Archer
description: Smart-mouthed superspy Sterling Archer and his dysfunctional team of secret agents turn dangerous missions into messy misadventures around the globe.

videos.title: Archersaurus
videos.overview: The "original" pilot where Archer is portrayed by a screeching dinosaur

videos.title: Unaired Network Promo
videos.overview: A guick promo featuring Archer in his "sex robe."

videos.title: Heart of Archness (1)
videos.overview: Malory hires an adventurer named Rip Riley to find Archer, who has been missing since his fiancée was murdered on their wedding day. Rip finds him on a tropical island, but Archer has no interest in leaving.

videos.title: Heart of Archness (2)
videos.overview: On the tropical island, Archer has emerged as Pirate King and must deal with it. Meanwhile, his ISIS colleagues keep up their attempts to rescue him. Sort of.

videos.title: Heart of Archness (3)
videos.overview: Archer and his fellow prisoners attempt to escape from the Pirate Fortress. Meanwhile, Malory plays hardball in ransom negotiations.

videos.title: L'Espion Mal Fait
videos.overview: A non-canon short that has Archer surviving a bomb blast, only to awaken in a shorter, balder, less handsome body—the body of the man who voices him, H. Jon Benjamin.

videos.title: Danger Zone
videos.overview: Archer heads into the Danger Zone.

videos.title: With Conan O'Brien
videos.overview: Conan is picked up by Archer and suddenly finds himself embroiled in a high-speed pursuit while dealing with Tinder, the merits of Uber, and the tenacity of the Russian mob.

videos.title: Book-on-Tape Fail
videos.overview: A promo for the upcoming book How to Archer: The Ultimate Guide to Espionage and Style and Also Cocktails Ever Written.

videos.title: Cooking with Archer
videos.overview: Archer and celebrity chef Alton Brown teach us how to make "Eggs Woodhouse."

videos.title: "Gator 2" Trailer
videos.overview: Archer makes his own trailer for his proposed Gator sequel

videos.title: Archer Season 3 at Comic-Con 2012
videos.overview: Archer delivers a special message to the show's nerdiest fans

videos.title: Heart of Archness Trilogy Enhanced
videos.overview: The Heart of Archness episodes re-cut as one hour-long special.

videos.title: Fishermans Daughter
videos.overview: The ISIS crew gets an anime treatment in these disturbingly hilarious clips from Krieger’s “Fisherman’s Daughter” hentai film.

videos.title: Archer Live!
videos.overview: Footage from the Archer Live! comedy event that took place January 12, 2013 at Irving Plaza in New York. The cast recreate scenes from the show on stage and answer questions from the audience. Also includes interviews with the cast and the fans. Those present include stars H. Jon Benjamin, Jessica Walter, Aisha Tyler, Amber Nash, and Lucky Yates, and executive producer Matt Thompson.

videos.title: "Midnight Blues" Music Video by Cherlene Tunt
videos.overview: "Midnight Blues" Music Video by Cherlene Tunt.

videos.title: Cherlene Tunt Interview on Wake Up Country
videos.overview: Cherlene Tunt Interview on Wake Up Country.

videos.title: Old Pam Poovey
videos.overview: Old Pam Poovey Had a Farm, the Musical.

videos.title: Season 1 Deleted Scenes
videos.overview: Deleted Scenes from Season 1.

videos.title: The Making of Archer
videos.overview: A five part making-of featurette that shows exactly how the show is created, from the animation and 3D effects to the background illustrations and art direction in general.

videos.title: Archersaurus - Self Extinction
videos.overview: A mini-episode in which Archer is transmogrified into a velociraptor

videos.title: Dear Archer
videos.overview: Archer fields a few fan-submitted questions.

videos.title: Semper Fi
videos.overview: Archer gives a shout-out to specialist Andrew Buckman and all the guys of Able Company, serving in Afghanistan.

videos.title: ISIS Infiltrates Comic-Con
videos.overview: The show's stars show up at Comic-Con to answer questions from fans.

videos.title: Slay-J
videos.overview: A longer fantasy sequence presented in part in one episode with the team imagining a rather fanciful future for Archer and Lana's baby girl

videos.title: Cooking with Milton
videos.overview: A faux piece of vintage videotape.

videos.title: Archer Comic Con Message - SDCC 15
videos.overview: Sterling Archer has some thoughts about this year's Comic Con.

videos.title: Archer Reviews Every James Bond Film
videos.overview: Entertainment Weekly has tasked Archer with reviewing all 24 James Bond, and he delivers.

videos.title: That Time Archer Met Kingsman
videos.overview: While trying to get a new suit, Archer meets Eggsy from the Kingsmen in a promo for the Kingsman: Golden Circle movie.

videos.title: Archer, P.I.
videos.overview: Get your moustache on and go full magnum for the next season of Archer.

videos.title: Archer, P.I. App Promo
videos.overview: We'd tell you how the Archer, P.I. App works... But it's so much more fun to let Sterling do it.

videos.title: Mole Hunt
videos.overview: Archer is in trouble with his Mother and the Comptroller because his expense account is way out of proportion to his actual expenses. So he creates the idea that a Mole has breached ISIS and he needs to get into the mainframe to hunt him down (so he can cover his tracks!). All this leads to a surprising ending.

videos.title: Training Day
videos.overview: Lana's residual lust for Archer prompts Malory to promote Cyril to field agent. Archer then trains his new competition as only he can, whilst Malory frets over her own past and her son's future.

videos.title: Diversity Hire
videos.overview: Owing to a rash of agent deaths (the result of Sterling's carelessness), ISIS can't meet government diversity standards. Enter the gruffly elegant Conway Stern, an "onyx" agent who wears a Star of David around his neck. Conway is "a diversity double whammy," gushes Malory, but that and his secret-agent skills aren't the only reasons she hired him.

videos.title: Killing Utne
videos.overview: Malory hosts a dinner party for the UN intelligence chairman, Torvald Utne, in an effort to get a new weapons contract for ISIS. Unfortunately, a group of rival assassins have targeted Mr. Utne for elimination.

videos.title: Honeypot
videos.overview: Malory's career is threatened when a sensitive videotape falls into the hands of a rogue (and roguish) Cuban agent, so she calls on Archer’s expertise in seduction to turn the tables on her blackmailer.

videos.title: Skorpio
videos.overview: Archer must rescue Lana from the clutches of Skorpio, the infamous arms dealer. Meanwhile, Cyril fears not only for his girlfriend's life, but her succumbing to the seductive nature of Archer's heroics.

videos.title: Skytanic
videos.overview: When a bomb threat jeopardizes the maiden voyage of the luxury airship Excelsior, Archer and the ISIS crew must battle the clock (and each other) to avert disaster.

videos.title: The Rock
videos.overview: After ISIS loses yet another lucrative contract to rival agency ODIN, Malory assigns Archer and Lana to embarrass ODIN by stealing a priceless diamond from their biggest client.

videos.title: Job Offer
videos.overview: When Archer takes a higher-paying job at rival agency ODIN, Malory will stop at nothing to get him back.

videos.title: Dial M for Mother
videos.overview: Questions about the identity of Archer's real father lead him into a perilous trap... and an explosive confrontation with Malory.

videos.title: Swiss Miss
videos.overview: In yet another attempt to secure funding for ISIS, Malory drags her agents to the luxury winter resort town of Gstaad to protect a Swiss billionaire's daughter from a kidnapping threat. But Archer soon finds out the real threat is his protectee: an underage nymphomaniac who will stop at nothing to bed the world’s greatest spy.

videos.title: A Going Concern
videos.overview: After Malory is wiped out in a Ponzi scheme, she hatches a scheme of her own: selling ISIS - lock, stock and snack machines - to archrival spy agency ODIN. Archer and the rest of the ISIS employees, rightfully fearing for their jobs, must use every trick in the book (ISIS Field Manual, 3rd Edition) to try to stop the sale.

videos.title: Blood Test
videos.overview: When Archer's favorite call girl suddenly arrives for a visit, Archer is shocked to learn that she claims her new baby boy was fathered by him.  She obtains a court order that forces him to take a paternity test in hopes of proving her claim.

videos.title: Pipeline Fever
videos.overview: Archer and Lana head to Louisiana to stop an ecoterrorist from blowing up a natural-gas pipeline. (Archer’s also looking forward to a Big Easy vacation.) Back at ISIS headquarters, Mallory orders the staff to go green to get “freebie socialist tax credits.” A flashback recalls Lana’s introduction to ISIS.

videos.title: The Double Deuce
videos.overview: When members of Woodhouse's famed WWI Royal Flying Corps squadron start dying mysteriously, Archer tries to track down the killer.

videos.title: Tragical History
videos.overview: Cyril agrees to help George Spelvin inject a virus into the ISIS mainframe so Cyril can defeat the virus and be seen as a hero.

videos.title: Movie Star
videos.overview: On Malory's orders, Lana helps Hollywood star Rona Thorne (voice of Rachael Harris) research her role in a spy thriller while Malory writes a role for herself in the movie (with Cyril's reluctant assistance). Meanwhile, Pam steals Rona's diary.

videos.title: Stage Two
videos.overview: Breast cancer strikes the Archer family---Sterling has it. "I'm trying to stay positive," he says. "I can beat this." But before surgery, he wants to bond with young Seamus (even though he isn't actually the baby's father) and take a Las Vegas vacation.

videos.title: Placebo Effect
videos.overview: When Archer discovers that the chemotherapy drugs he has been taking are phony, he goes on a rampage against the Irish gangsters behind the scheme. He also makes friends with a fellow marijuana-toking cancer patient (voice of Joan Van Ark). Meanwhile, Cyril learns why Krieger is fluent in Portuguese.

videos.title: El Secuestro
videos.overview: Pam is abducted by kidnappers who mistake her for Cheryl. It seems that Cheryl wasn’t completely forthcoming about her background when she applied for her job at ISIS.

videos.title: Jeu Monegasque
videos.overview: When a mysterious stranger summons Malory and her intrepid ISIS agents to Monaco, all bets are off! Well, actually all bets are on. Because Monaco is basically one giant casino, and Archer has $4 million in untraceable bearer bonds. Also, it's Gran Prix week, so you can just forget getting a hotel room

videos.title: White Nights
videos.overview: Archer's search for his father's identity leads him into hot water.  Agent Barry Dylan is sent to rescue Archer.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: Krieger works to finish a top-secret project, and Archer brings a mysterious former KGB agent named Katya Kazanova home to meet Malory.

videos.title: The Man from Jupiter
videos.overview: Archer is shocked to learn that his mother is dating Archer's idol/hero/man-crush, Burt Reynolds.

videos.title: El Contador
videos.overview: Cyril is promoted to field agent, while Malory institutes a strict drug-testing policy. Neither of which sit well with the staff of ISIS.

videos.title: The Limited
videos.overview: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police enlist the help of ISIS to transport a captured Canadian terrorist. On a train.

videos.title: Drift Problem
videos.overview: Archer's surprise birthday present - a high-tech, souped-up spy car - leads to all sorts of other surprises. None of which are good.

videos.title: Lo Scandalo
videos.overview: Malory turns to Archer and Lana for help when she finds herself in a compromising situation with the Italian prime minister.

videos.title: Bloody Ferlin
videos.overview: Archer must help Gillette save his younger brother from a crooked sheriff in the backwoods of West Virginia.

videos.title: Crossing Over
videos.overview: Archer's sex life compromises his effectiveness as an agent. But more seriously than the countless other times.

videos.title: Skin Game
videos.overview: Archer is faced with a dilemma when his murdered fiance, Katya, miraculously reappears. In Krieger's lab.

videos.title: Space Race (1)
videos.overview: Archer and his colleagues at ISIS voyage to the final frontier in an effort to prevent a catastrophe on the International Space Station.

videos.title: Space Race (2)
videos.overview: Archer and the rest of ISIS are held captive by mutineers on the International Space Station.

videos.title: Fugue and Riffs
videos.overview: Archer has amnesia and decides the only cure is a spa weekend.

videos.title: The Wind Cries Mary
videos.overview: Archer and his former best friend are holed up in the Vermont wilderness, fighting hard to come out on top.

videos.title: Legs
videos.overview: Archer's fear of cyborgs hits home when Krieger offers to make robotic legs for Gillette.

videos.title: Midnight Ron
videos.overview: The beginning of beautiful hatred between Archer and his new stepfather plays out as the two are chased by gangsters.

videos.title: Viscous Coupling
videos.overview: Archer's former fiancée calls on him to rescue her cyborg boyfriend from outer space, but he has other things on his mind.

videos.title: Once Bitten
videos.overview: Archer is bitten by a snake in a "special place".

videos.title: Live and Let Dine
videos.overview: Archer, Lana, and Cyril go undercover in celebrity chef Lance Casteau's hellish kitchen.

videos.title: Coyote Lovely
videos.overview: Archer heads to the Mexican border to capture a notorious coyote, which is Spanish for coyote.

videos.title: The Honeymooners
videos.overview: Archer and Lana pose as newlyweds to stop a sale of enriched uranium.

videos.title: Un Chien Tangerine
videos.overview: Archer and Lana extract an agent from Morocco only to find out his bark is worse than his bite.

videos.title: The Papal Chase
videos.overview: Archer must rescue the Pope from an assassination plot using Woodhouse as a decoy. Operation Bad Habit is a go.

videos.title: Sea Tunt (1)
videos.overview: Cheryl's brother Cecil Tunt and his girlfriend Tiffy drive her crazier than usual as they travel into the Bermuda Triangle. Where mysteries abound!.

videos.title: Sea Tunt (2)
videos.overview: Archer and the ISIS crew go to an underwater SEA LABoratory to stop the deranged Captain Murphy.

videos.title: White Elephant
videos.overview: ISIS is raided and disbanded by the U.S. government when it transpires that the agency was never sanctioned by them. Its former staff discover a hidden vault containing one-ton of cocaine, and form a drug cartel to sell the drugs to fund their retirements.

videos.title: A Kiss While Dying
videos.overview: Archer, Pam and Lana travel to Miami to visit some old friends. It's a fondue party!

videos.title: A Debt of Honor
videos.overview: Pam makes a deal that puts everyone in danger; Archer dons his slightly darker black suit.

videos.title: House Call
videos.overview: Archer has to stage an intervention for Pam that gets derailed by an unwanted guest.

videos.title: Southbound and Down
videos.overview: Malory buys a bus and takes everyone on a road trip. Put that hammer down and give it hell.

videos.title: Baby Shower
videos.overview: Archer decides to give Lana the perfect baby shower gift by forcing Kenny Loggins to sing a duet with Cherlene. Something something Danja Zown!

videos.title: Smugglers' Blues
videos.overview: Archer travels to Columbia on a secret mission that becomes not so secret after he gets drunk.

videos.title: The Rules of Extraction
videos.overview: Archer, Ray, and Cyril raft down a crocodile-filled river while Lana and Pam plan a spa day for Malory.

videos.title: On the Carpet
videos.overview: Archer avoids crash landing in a dangerous swamp only to come face-to-face with a shady arms dealer.

videos.title: Palace Intrigue (1)
videos.overview: Archer and the rest of the ISIS gang are the guests of Gustavo Calderon and his wife Juliana. Calderon is a big fan of Cherlene but Juliana is a bigger fan of Archer.

videos.title: Palace Intrigue (2)
videos.overview: Archer tries to keep his fling with the dictator's wife a secret while Krieger bonds with his clone-brothers.

videos.title: Filibuster
videos.overview: Cyril becomes the new president of San Marcos, Cherlene becomes the first lady of country music, and Archer becomes a resistance fighter.

videos.title: Arrival/Departure
videos.overview: Archer helps Lana with the delivery of her baby, while Krieger tries to prevent the delivery of a deadly weapon.

videos.title: The Holdout
videos.overview: Archer must salvage a crashed plane in a jungle filled with relics from World War II.

videos.title: Three to Tango
videos.overview: An agent from the past has a hand in creating tension between Archer and Lana.

videos.title: The Archer Sanction
videos.overview: Archer, Lana, and Ray climb their way to the top of an assassin’s hit list.

videos.title: Edie's Wedding
videos.overview: Pam takes Archer to her sister's wedding but gets side-tracked with technical difficulties.

videos.title: Vision Quest
videos.overview: The gang gets to work early so they can spend some quality time together.

videos.title: Sitting
videos.overview: Archer’s first weekend alone with baby AJ is soiled by a Pakistani intelligence officer.

videos.title: Nellis
videos.overview: A rescue mission turns into an out-of-this-world visit to Area 51.

videos.title: The Kanes
videos.overview: Lana introduces Archer to her parents. Archer introduces Lana's parents to high-speed chases.

videos.title: Pocket Listing
videos.overview: Slater has the gang swindle the Durhani royal family and Gillette lends a hand.

videos.title: Reignition Sequence
videos.overview: An office romance is interrupted by the Russians.

videos.title: Achub Y Morfilod
videos.overview: Archer and Lana travel to Wales for a romantic getaway of aiding separatists.

videos.title: Drastic Voyage (1)
videos.overview: Archer and the gang prepare for their most fantastic voyage ever.

videos.title: Drastic Voyage (2)
videos.overview: The fantastic voyage concludes.

videos.title: The Figgis Agency
videos.overview: In the seventh season premiere, Archer breaks into a mansion to repair a Hollywood starlet's honor.

videos.title: The Handoff
videos.overview: Archer and Lana make a handoff while the others listen to the best voicemail ever.

videos.title: Deadly Prep
videos.overview: A business opportunity arises at a prep school reunion.

videos.title: Motherless Child
videos.overview: A mysterious stranger surfaces and asks Archer to help him find his birth mother.

videos.title: Bel Panto (1)
videos.overview: A fundraiser goes awry due to party crashers.

videos.title: Bel Panto (2)
videos.overview: Archer and Lana go missing as a hostage situation gets out of control

videos.title: Double Indecency
videos.overview: Who's sexier, Cyril or Krieger? Pam or Cheryl? Only one way to find out: bar fight!

videos.title: Liquid Lunch
videos.overview: The on-again, off-again relationship of Archer and Slater causes a rift in the on-again, off-again relationship of Archer and Lana.

videos.title: Deadly Velvet (1)
videos.overview: Archer and the gang are hired by renowned director, Ellis Crane, to investigate suspicious activity on the set of his new movie, Deadly Velvet.

videos.title: Deadly Velvet (2)
videos.overview: Things get even deadlier on the set of Deadly Velvet when someone turns up, you guessed it, dead.

videos.title: No Good Deed
videos.overview: Archer tries to find out who killed his partner, but accidentally gets in bed with Mother, a notorious L.A. crime boss.

videos.title: Berenice
videos.overview: A mysterious woman hires Archer to fake her death but Archer is unable to rise to the occasion.

videos.title: Jane Doe
videos.overview: Archer tries to escape from jail with the help of a crazed heiress and a dysfunctional jazz quartet.

videos.title: Ladyfingers
videos.overview: While investigating a kidnapping, Archer reveals too much about Figgis and Krieger reveals too much about his past.

videos.title: Sleepers Wake
videos.overview: Lana tries to seduce Archer for a cut of the ransom as he races Figgis and Poovey to collect the money.

videos.title: Waxing Gibbous
videos.overview: All roads lead to Len Trexler as Archer and the gang try to avoid unfriendly ghosts.

videos.title: Gramercy, Halberd!
videos.overview: Archer and Trexler try to escape a rampaging Dutch by telling the world's worst knock-knock joke.

videos.title: Auflösung
videos.overview: Archer visits Dreamland and receives a big break that leads him to Woodhouse's killer.

videos.title: Strange Pilot
videos.overview: Archer inserts himself into a domestic dispute and engine troubles threaten to ruin his business.

videos.title: Disheartening Situation
videos.overview: Archer estimates his impact on the world while Pam samples the local nightlife.

videos.title: Different Modes of Preparing the Fruit
videos.overview: Archer, Pam, and Crackers try to find the missing key to their latest get-rich-quick scheme.

videos.title: A Warrior in Costume
videos.overview: Archer keeps an eye out for a past nemesis.

videos.title: Strange Doings in the Taboo Groves
videos.overview: But there is no joy in Mudville- mighty Pam has struck out.

videos.title: Some Remarks on Cannibalism
videos.overview: Archer and Pam try to escape the cannibals with the less-than-willing help of an anthropologist while everyone else races to the idol.

videos.title: Comparative Wickedness of Civilized and Unenlightened Peoples
videos.overview: Archer helps defend a village from party crashers intent on ruining oysterfest.

videos.title: A Discovery
videos.overview: The Band finally close on a discovery.

videos.title: Bort the Garj
videos.overview: Archer and the crew of the Seamus wake up to the smell of shepherd's pie and see a business opportunity in their new guest.

videos.title: Happy Borthday
videos.overview: The crew provides entertainment for Bort while Barry-6 tries to crack Archer's safe.

videos.title: The Leftovers
videos.overview: Pam's sandwich ruins everyone's dinner by releasing something deep inside of them.

videos.title: Dining with the Zarglorp
videos.overview: Deep in space, Archer and the crew encounter a terrifying cosmic beast. Even deeper, they encounter a self-aggrandizing life coach.

videos.title: Mr. Deadly Goes to Town
videos.overview: Archer and the crew pick up a hitchhiker and try to convince him to turn his life around.

videos.title: Road Trip
videos.overview: Daydreams of an interstellar road trip turn into an existential nightmare. Written by Mike Arnold.

videos.title: Space Pirates
videos.overview: A voyage home gets interrupted by an alien battle cruiser carrying precious cargo.

videos.title: Cubert
videos.overview: Archer is convinced a mysterious object is causing the crew to act strangely. Is it magnetic? Is it supernatural? Does it need to be cleaned with some sterile wipes?

videos.title: Robert De Niro
videos.overview: When a trial turns into a party it can only mean that Barry-6 has returned!

videos.title: The Orpheus Gambit
videos.overview: Archer is back in the spy game and his first mission is to guard a priceless statue; then, he must tell Lana his true feelings and get blind drunk.

videos.title: Bloodsploosh
videos.overview: Archer and the gang attend a martial arts tournament to capture an international arms dealer.

videos.title: Helping Hands
videos.overview: The Agency attempts to steal experimental technology from a reclusive inventor, but they forgot one vital item... Sterling Archer.

videos.title: Robot Factory
videos.overview: Archer and the gang team up with Barry to stop an army of Barrys from turning the world into Barrys.

videos.title: Best Friends
videos.overview: Archer is head over heels for his new valet, Aleister. Will Archer do Aleister's recommended rehabilitation exercises or just eat himself to death?

videos.title: The Double Date
videos.overview: Archer shows off his date to Lana. Cyril shows Archer's date a top-secret dossier. Archer's date shows Archer his innermost desires.

videos.title: Caught Napping
videos.overview: When AJ is kidnapped, it's up to Archer to get her back and keep Lana's rampage pointed in the right direction.

videos.title: Cold Fusion
videos.overview: Archer and the gang travel to Antarctica to solve a murder mystery with international implications.

videos.title: Identity Crisis
videos.overview: Archer and the gang just saved the world from a nuclear catastrophe and their reward is five nights in a rat-infested Moldovan hotel.

videos.title: Lowjacked
videos.overview: The Agency embarks on a team building exercise that doesn't quite get off the ground.

videos.title: London Time
videos.overview: A mission across the pond turns into a trip down memory lane for Malory while Cheryl/Carol teaches Pam about British history.

videos.title: Photo Op
videos.overview: Archer and Lana face off against snakes, crocodiles and mercenaries to reunite a family.

videos.title: Shots
videos.overview: Sex, drugs, and monster trucks! Archer and the gang celebrate another barely successful mission.

videos.title: Dingo, Baby, Et Cetera
videos.overview: Lana makes rookie mistakes as ghosts from Archer's past haunt him on a special mission.

videos.title: Colt Express
videos.overview: A mysterious stranger and a scavenger hunt helps Archer and the gang get a jump on their enemies.

videos.title: Mission: Difficult
videos.overview: Archer is trapped inside IIA headquarters and Barry is trapped inside Other Barry.

videos.title: The Big Con
videos.overview: Free drinks, party rooms and swag bags are just a few of the things the gang is not enjoying at the world's foremost spy convention, Clandesti-con!

videos.title: Operation: Fang
videos.overview: Gillette is in charge of a creepy crawly mission in a tropical jungle.

videos.title: Saturday
videos.overview: Mommy daughter day turns into a lesson in fellowship and tactical awareness.

videos.title: The Laws of Attraction
videos.overview: Fabian tasks The Agency with recovering a piece of valuable tech from a nefarious threat, the Swiss!

videos.title: Out of Network
videos.overview: Archer seeks professional help but IIA's health plan is murder.

videos.title: Bank Run at Mr. Bank's Bank
videos.overview: Is Fabian asking The Agency to rob a bank? No, because we won't use those words.

videos.title: Distraction Action
videos.overview: Archer has a brilliant plan to evade capture. There is only one problem, he refuses to follow it.

videos.title: Dough, Ray and Me
videos.overview: Archer and the gang knead proof in order to temper expectations and ice the mission.

awards: Won 3 Primetime Emmys. 15 wins & 81 nominations total
